hours.title: Business hours
hours.description: Days and times when the agent responds. Outside them, it does not respond.

enabledReminder.label: Remind the customer
enabledReminder.hint: Sends a reminder when the customer stops responding in the middle of the conversation.

splitMessages.label: Split long responses
splitMessages.hint: Long responses arrive as several short messages, the way a person would write.

signMessages.label: Sign messages
signMessages.hint: Includes the agent's name in every response.

problems.startBeforeEnd: the start must be before the end

hours.disabledHint: With no business hours set, the agent responds 24 hours a day, every day.
hours.timezoneHint: The hours below apply in this time zone (e.g.: America/Sao_Paulo, America/Manaus).
hours.transferHint: Outside business hours, the conversation goes to the available operator of the Open Channel and the agent stops responding in it. For the service to happen, the Open Channel's working hours must be configured in Bitrix24. The conversation only returns to the agent when the operator closes it.
hours.messageHintTransfer: Sent to the customer before the conversation goes to the human agent, without using credits. If blank, the conversation is transferred without notice.
hours.messageHintSilent: Sent once every 12 hours to anyone who writes outside business hours, without using credits. If blank, the agent stays silent. Messages sent outside business hours are not answered later.

image.tooLarge: The image exceeds the {max} MB limit.
